applies_to.quote: The Trade Receivables Discounting System Platform Operators and Participants

answer.action: TReDS platform operators must comply with capital requirements, maintain required net-worth, conduct due diligence, file assignment records, and submit periodic regulatory returns.
answer.action_quote: An applicant shall have a minimum net-worth of ₹25 crore and shall submit a certificate in the format from its statutory auditor.

effective_date.quote: These Directions shall be termed as the Reserve Bank of India (Trade Receivables Discounting System) Directions, 2026 and shall be effective immediately.

comply_by.quote: Existing entities authorised to operate TReDS platform shall ensure that net-worth criterion is met latest by March 31, 2028.
comply_by.what: Meet the minimum net-worth criterion of 25 crore.

answer.amends: Guidelines for the Trade Receivables Discounting System (TReDS)
